Description of agent levels
  1. LV1 · A1–A2Your directly invited agents.
  2. LV2 · B1–B4Agents invited by your LV1 agents.
  3. LV3 · C1–C8Agents invited by your LV2 agents.

You can receive a percentage of commission from bets and recharge amounts made by agents at levels A, B and C. Refer to the commission rates below.

What is a club?

You and all your agents form your ET7 club. The higher the club’s star rating, the higher the rebate ratio.

Frequently asked questions
What does commission split mean?
After inviting friends to join the ET7 APK & APP and bind your invitation code, you receive additional commission based on their consumption at the applicable ratio.
What does club mean?
Your club consists of all your agent team members.
How can I upgrade to a higher club star rating?
You can upgrade by inviting more friends or through collective consumption with your team members. Refer to the upgrade requirements table above for details.
How do I receive rewards?
Once your friends or people invited by your friends make purchases, the rewards are deposited into your commission account and can be withdrawn to your wallet the next day.
Are there any wagering requirements for withdrawing rewards?
There is a one-time wagering requirement.
When can I use my rewards?
You can withdraw your rewards to your wallet for spending the next day. Sometimes there may be slight delays.
